### Fruitfulness Versus Faithfulness
Author: Ginger Plowman
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-2-16-04-1243611.html
Passage: Ephesians 6:7-8
Points:
- God rewards genuine faithfulness rather than public prominence, placing equal value on quiet, behind-the-scenes service.
- Even when earthly superiors or family members fail to appreciate our hard work, the Lord sees and honors every good deed.
- Maintaining the mindset that Christ is our true supervisor provides endurance when facing ungracious leaders or unrewarded labor.
- Serving wholeheartedly does not earn salvation, but flows out of love for God and shines as a testimony before unbelievers.
